scenario: 题目要求生成所有满足规则的配置，并且每一步选择后都能立刻检查是否违反约束。
q: 这种题最应该先考虑哪种模式？
options: 贪心排序
系统性回溯搜索并剪枝
只用哈希表计数
单源最短路
why: 需要枚举合法组合，且约束能提前排除分支，这是回溯的典型信号。关键不是一次算出公式，而是逐步构造、发现无效就退回。
why_en: Backtracking fits when you must enumerate valid combinations and constraints let you prune partial choices early.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标只是求一个最优值并且子问题大量重叠，动态规划通常更合适；如果局部最优总能保证全局最优，贪心更简单。
tradeoff: 系统性枚举+剪枝 vs 直接求单个值（计数/最短路/局部贪心选择）
options_en: Greedy sorting.
Systematic backtracking search with pruning.
Just use a hash table to count.
Single-source shortest path.
optionExplanations: 贪心只在局部最优必然导致全局最优时适用；这里需要枚举所有满足约束的配置，直接排序拿不到全部合法解。
约束能在每一步提前排除分支，这正是回溯要系统枚举、边搜边剪的信号。
哈希表能查找或去重，但它不会替你搜索组合空间、也不会应用约束。
这是图上按边权找最短距离的问题，和枚举满足规则的配置是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Greedy only works when the locally best pick always yields the globally best result; here you must enumerate every valid configuration, so sorting alone cannot produce all solutions.
Constraints can rule out a branch at each step, which is exactly the signal for systematic backtracking with pruning.
A hash table is good for lookup or counting, but it will not search the combination space or apply constraints for you.
This finds the shortest weighted distance in a graph, a different problem from enumerating configurations that satisfy rules.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提前判断某个分支不可能得到合法解，直接跳过整棵子树而不再探索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning means recognizing early that a branch cannot lead to a valid solution and skipping its entire subtree.

q: 哪些题型通常会落到回溯或约束满足？
options: 在棋盘或网格中摆放元素且不能冲突
给任务、资源或班次做受约束的分配
生成满足依赖规则的系统配置
在无权图中只求一条最短路径
why: 摆放、分配、配置生成都要求在组合空间里试选择，并用约束剪掉无效分支。无权最短路径通常是 BFS 的图搜索问题。
why_en: Placement, assignment, and configuration-generation tasks share the incremental-choice structure that backtracking exploits.
options_en: Placing elements on a board or grid without conflicts.
Constrained assignment of tasks, resources, or shifts.
Generating system configurations that satisfy dependency rules.
Finding a single shortest path in an unweighted graph.
optionExplanations: 棋盘/网格摆放要满足互不冲突的约束，摆一个就要检查是否影响后续格子，这正是回溯的组合搜索模式。
任务/资源/班次分配要满足可用性、容量等约束，逐个分配并在违反时回退，属于受约束分配的回溯形状。
依赖规则会让某些配置组合非法，需要在生成过程中随时检查依赖是否满足，也是典型的回溯/约束满足场景。
单一最短路径按边一层层向外扩展找最近节点，不涉及在组合空间里选择、检验、撤销的搜索结构。
optionExplanations_en: Placing pieces on a board or grid must avoid conflicts, and each placement has to be checked against future cells — exactly backtracking's combinatorial search shape.
Assigning tasks, resources, or shifts under availability and capacity limits, backing off whenever a rule breaks, is the constrained-assignment shape of backtracking.
Dependency rules can make some configuration combinations invalid, so you must check dependencies while generating them, a typical constraint-satisfaction case.
A single shortest-path search expands outward by edges to find the nearest node; it has no choose-check-undo structure over a combination space.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS, breadth-first search, expands one layer at a time and is the standard way to find shortest paths in an unweighted graph.

q: 几乎所有回溯解法的核心节奏是什么？
options: 排序、扫描、合并
入队、出队、访问
选择、探索、撤销选择
建表、填表、返回右下角
why: 你先把一个选择写入状态，递归探索它，然后在尝试下一个选择前把状态恢复。这个撤销动作是代码正确性的核心。
why_en: The core backtracking rhythm is choose, explore recursively, then unchoose before trying the next branch.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[选择一个候选] --> B[写入状态]
  B --> C[递归探索]
  C --> D[撤销该选择]
  D --> E[尝试下一个候选]
options_en: Sort, scan, merge.
Enqueue, dequeue, visit.
Choose, explore, unchoose.
Build table, fill table, return bottom-right cell.
optionExplanations: 这是归并排序一类算法的节奏，不是回溯需要的做-撤销结构。
这是 BFS/队列遍历的节奏，回溯用的是递归深度优先，不是逐层出队。
先写入一个选择、递归探索它，再撤销，这正是几乎所有回溯代码共享的节奏。
这是动态规划自底向上填表的节奏，回溯不预先建一张完整的表。
optionExplanations_en: That is the rhythm of algorithms like merge sort, not the choose-and-undo structure backtracking needs.
That is the rhythm of BFS with a queue; backtracking recurses depth-first instead of processing level by level.
Write in a choice, recurse into it, then undo it — the rhythm nearly every backtracking solution shares.
That is the rhythm of bottom-up dynamic programming filling a table; backtracking does not pre-build a full table.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming, DP, caches the results of overlapping subproblems to compute an optimal value or a count without redoing the same work.

scenario: AI 生成了一段通用回溯模板，你要审查这份代码里最容易被漏写、但直接决定正确性的操作。
q: 这段回溯模板最容易被漏掉、但必须检查的行是哪一类？
options: 递归前的 is_valid 检查
递归后的 undo / 恢复共享状态
for 循环本身
函数参数里的 choices
why: AI 通常能写出递归，但共享状态一旦没有恢复，前一个分支的选择会污染后一个分支。审查回溯代码时要逐项确认每个修改都有反向操作。
why_en: The unchoose step prevents state from one branch leaking into the next branch.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Choose[Choose] --> Check[Check]
  Check --> Explore[Explore]
  Explore --> Undo[Undo]
  Undo --> Next[Next choice]
options_en: The is_valid check before recursing.
The undo / restore-shared-state step after recursing.
The for loop itself.
The choices parameter itself.
optionExplanations: is_valid 检查很少被漏掉，因为它是代码明显要判断的一步，AI 通常会主动写。
AI 几乎总会写递归，但常常忘了在递归返回后撤销对共享状态的修改，导致下一个分支带着上一个分支的痕迹运行。
for 循环负责遍历候选，本身不涉及状态修改，不是容易漏写的部分。
choices 只是传入的候选集合，不需要额外撤销逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: The is_valid check is rarely skipped because it is an obvious step to write, so models usually include it.
Models almost always write the recursion, but often forget to undo the shared-state change after it returns, so the next branch runs with leftover state.
The for loop just iterates over candidates; it does not touch shared state and is not the part that gets forgotten.
choices is just the passed-in candidate set and needs no undo logic of its own.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断把某个候选值加入当前状态后是否仍然满足所有约束的检查函数。

q: 如果回溯代码忘记撤销对列表、集合或网格的修改，最典型的后果是什么？
options: 算法只会慢一些，但答案仍然正确
上一个分支的状态泄漏到下一个分支，导致漏解或错解
时间复杂度自动降到 O(n)
递归会变成 BFS
why: 回溯依赖共享状态的可逆修改。没有恢复，后续分支是在错误前提下运行，很多小样例可能看不出但大样例会错。
why_en: Missing restoration contaminates later branches with stale state and can silently produce wrong results.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Branch1[Branch 1] --> State[Shared state]
  State --> Branch2[Branch 2 polluted]
  Branch2 --> Wrong[Wrong result]
options_en: The algorithm is only a bit slower, but the answer is still correct.
State from the previous branch leaks into the next branch, causing missed or wrong solutions.
Time complexity automatically drops to O(n).
The recursion turns into BFS.
optionExplanations: 污染的是正确性，不只是速度——被污染的分支可能直接产出错误或缺失的解，不只是变慢。
共享状态没恢复，下一个分支会带着上一个分支残留的选择继续搜索，结果可能漏掉合法解或产出非法解。
撤销与否不会改变算法本身的时间复杂度，不会自动降到线性。
递归结构和是否撤销状态无关，不会因此变成广度优先的队列遍历。
optionExplanations_en: The damage is to correctness, not just speed — a contaminated branch can directly produce wrong or missing solutions, not merely run slower.
Without restoring shared state, the next branch keeps searching with leftover choices from the previous branch, which can miss valid solutions or produce invalid ones.
Whether you undo or not does not change the algorithm's time complexity; it does not automatically drop to linear.
The recursive structure has nothing to do with undoing state, so it does not turn into a breadth-first queue traversal.

scenario: 你要让 AI 写 N 皇后，目标是在尝试某个格子时 O(1) 判断列和两条对角线是否冲突。
q: 提示 AI 使用哪组状态最合适？
options: 整块棋盘二维数组，每次全表扫描
列集合加两条对角线集合，O(1)判重
一个队列，按顺序保存候选格子
一个最大堆，保存最近放置的皇后
why: 列集合和两个对角线集合能把冲突检查变成 O(1)。完整扫描也能做，但会把每次合法性判断变重，代码也更难审查。
why_en: Three sets for columns and diagonals give constant-time conflict checks in N-Queens.
whenOtherWins: 如果棋盘很小且只追求可读性，直接扫描也能通过；但面试里显式要求效率时应说出集合方案。
tradeoff: O(1) 集合判重 vs 每次全表扫描判重

flowchart TD

  Row --> D1[row minus col]
  Row --> D2[row plus col]
  Col --> OK[O one check]
  D1 --> OK
  D2 --> OK
options_en: A full 2D board scanned entirely every time.
A column set plus two diagonal sets for O(1) conflict checks.
A queue holding candidate cells in order.
A max-heap holding the most recently placed queen.
optionExplanations: 全表扫描能得到正确答案，但每次判断都要重新看已放置的皇后，随皇后数增多会变慢，也更难在代码里一眼看出为什么某格不行。
列集合和两条对角线集合能把冲突检查压到 O(1)，放置和撤销都只是加入/移除集合元素，审查代码也更直接。
队列是先进先出结构，适合按层展开的搜索（如 BFS），不提供 O(1) 判断某列/对角线是否被占用的能力。
堆用于快速取最大/最小值，和判断列、对角线是否冲突没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: A full scan gets the right answer, but each check has to look at every placed queen again, which slows down as more queens are placed.
A column set plus two diagonal sets push conflict checks down to O(1); placing and undoing a queen is just adding or removing set members.
A queue is a first-in-first-out structure suited to layer-by-layer search like BFS; it does not give O(1) checks for occupied columns or diagonals.
A heap is for quickly getting the max or min element, which has nothing to do with checking column or diagonal conflicts.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: N-Queens is the classic backtracking problem of placing N queens on an N-by-N board so that no two share a row, column, or diagonal.

scenario: AI 写完一个回溯求解器，你需要最快确认基本正确性，而题目空间很大。
q: 第一轮验证最应该怎么做？
options: 只看代码缩进是否漂亮
用小输入跑出可手动验证的解或解数量
直接压测最大输入
让 AI 口头保证正确
why: 回溯代码的错误通常能在小样例上暴露，而且小样例可以人工验证。先用小例子定位方向，再考虑性能压测。
why_en: Small hand-checkable cases catch most backtracking correctness bugs before performance testing matters.
whenOtherWins: 如果小样例已全部通过但仍担心超时，再用较大随机或压力输入检查剪枝效率。
tradeoff: 先用小样例人工验证 vs 直接上大输入压测
options_en: Only check whether the code indentation looks nice.
Run it on small inputs and get a solution or count you can verify by hand.
Immediately stress-test the largest possible input.
Have the AI verbally promise it's correct.
optionExplanations: 缩进好看和算法是否正确没有关系，看不出漏解、错解或状态污染。
小输入能让你手工数出正确答案，快速暴露漏解、重复解或状态污染，比直接跑大输入更容易定位问题。
大输入能测性能，但出错时很难判断是漏解还是效率问题，也不方便人工核对结果。
AI 的口头保证不能替代实际验证，回溯代码的错误往往要跑一遍才能发现。
optionExplanations_en: Nice indentation says nothing about correctness; it will not reveal missed solutions, wrong solutions, or state contamination.
A small input lets you count the correct answer by hand, quickly exposing missed solutions, duplicates, or contamination — easier to localize than a big input.
A large input tests performance, but when it fails it is hard to tell whether it is a missing-solution bug or just slow, and you cannot check it by hand.
The AI's verbal assurance is no substitute for actually running it; backtracking bugs usually only surface once you execute the code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上一个分支修改过的共享状态没有被撤销，被下一个分支意外沿用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state leak happens when a previous branch's changes to shared state are left in place and get inherited by the next branch.

q: 区分回溯和动态规划的一个实用问题是什么？
options: 我要枚举所有合法解，还是只要求一个最优值或计数？
代码里是否出现 for 循环？
输入是否包含字符串？
能否使用 Python 集合？
why: 枚举全部配置通常偏回溯；优化或计数且有重叠子问题时通常偏 DP。这个问题能防止你把看起来递归的题都交给回溯。
why_en: Enumeration points toward backtracking, while optimization or counting with overlapping subproblems points toward DP.
tradeoff: 枚举所有解(回溯) vs 求单一最优值/计数(DP)
options_en: Am I enumerating all valid solutions, or just asking for one optimal value or count?
Does the code contain a for loop?
Does the input include strings?
Can I use Python sets?
optionExplanations: 枚举全部合法配置通常指向回溯；求一个最优值或计数、且子问题会重复出现时通常指向动态规划。
for 循环在回溯、DP、遍历代码里都很常见，光看有没有循环判断不了该用哪种方法。
字符串只是输入的数据类型，不能决定该用回溯还是动态规划，两者都能处理字符串输入。
能不能用 Python 集合是实现细节，不是判断回溯还是 DP 的依据。
optionExplanations_en: Enumerating every valid configuration usually points to backtracking; wanting a single optimal value or count where subproblems repeat points to DP.
A for loop shows up in backtracking, DP, and plain iteration alike, so its presence alone cannot tell you which approach to use.
String input is just a data type; it does not decide between backtracking and DP, since both can handle string inputs.
Whether you can use a Python set is an implementation detail, not a basis for choosing backtracking versus DP.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带剪枝的系统性搜索：做一个选择、递归探索，发现不可能成功就撤销回到上一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 动态规划（DP）：通过缓存重叠子问题的结果来求最优值或计数，避免重复计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming, DP, caches the results of overlapping subproblems to compute an optimal value or a count without redoing the same work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同的搜索路径会反复计算同一个子问题，是应该考虑动态规划的信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overlapping subproblems happen when different search paths recompute the same subproblem, a signal that dynamic programming may help.

scenario: 你的回溯从不同路径反复到达同一个状态，且每次都重新搜索剩余子树。
q: 最合理的优化或转向是什么？
options: 给状态加 memo，形成自顶向下 DP
删掉所有剪枝
把递归改名为 bfs
只保留第一个分支
why: 重复访问同一状态是重叠子问题信号。缓存已探索状态能避免重复工作，这也是 top-down DP 的核心。
why_en: When backtracking revisits identical states, memoization turns repeated search into top-down dynamic programming.
whenOtherWins: 如果每条路径到达的状态都独一无二，memo 带来的收益很小，直接剪枝和排序选择可能更有用。
tradeoff: 缓存已访问状态换取更快求值 vs 保持纯回溯以枚举每个不同解
options_en: Add memoization to the state, turning it into top-down DP.
Remove all the pruning.
Rename the recursion to bfs.
Only keep the first branch.
optionExplanations: 同一个状态被不同路径反复到达是重叠子问题的信号，把结果缓存起来正是自顶向下 DP 的做法。
删掉剪枝只会让搜索空间变大，不能解决重复访问同一状态的问题。
改名不会改变算法行为，重复子问题依然存在，BFS 也不是这里要解决的问题。
只保留第一个分支会漏掉其他合法解，不是处理重复状态的正确方式。
optionExplanations_en: The same state being reached repeatedly from different paths is the signal for overlapping subproblems, and caching the result is exactly what top-down DP does.
Removing pruning only makes the search space bigger; it does not fix repeated visits to the same state.
Renaming the function does not change the algorithm's behavior, the repeated subproblem is still there, and BFS is not the issue here.
Keeping only the first branch would miss other valid solutions and is not the right way to handle repeated states.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的子问题结果缓存起来，下次遇到相同状态直接查表复用，不用重新搜索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Memoization caches the result of a subproblem so that a repeated state can be looked up instead of being searched again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从原问题出发递归拆解，用缓存记住已经算过的状态，等价于加了记忆化的回溯。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-down DP recurses from the original problem and caches states it has already solved, effectively backtracking with memoization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同的搜索路径会反复计算同一个子问题，是应该考虑动态规划的信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overlapping subproblems happen when different search paths recompute the same subproblem, a signal that dynamic programming may help.

q: 什么时候贪心比回溯更合适？
options: 每一步局部最优选择都能保证全局最优，不需要探索替代分支
需要列出所有合法解
任何选择都可能导致后续冲突，必须撤销重试
约束检查很复杂但没有最优性结构
why: 贪心的优势来自不回头：一次选择就能安全提交。只要需要枚举或可能要撤销选择，回溯或 DP 往往更自然。
why_en: Greedy wins when local choices can be committed without exploring alternatives.
tradeoff: 一次提交不回头(贪心) vs 需要枚举全部解或可能撤销选择(回溯/DP)
options_en: A locally optimal choice at every step is guaranteed to be globally optimal, so no alternative branches need exploring.
You need to list every valid solution.
Any choice might cause a later conflict and has to be undone and retried.
The constraint check is complex but there's no optimal-substructure.
optionExplanations: 贪心的前提是局部最优就能拼出全局最优；满足这个前提时不需要探索其他分支，一次选择就能安全提交。
要列出所有合法解通常是回溯的场景，贪心只提交一个答案，不天然枚举全部解。
选择可能导致后续冲突、需要撤销重试，正是贪心不适用、该用回溯的信号，不是贪心更合适的理由。
约束复杂但没有最优子结构时，两者都可能需要评估；但这个条件本身不能说明贪心比回溯更合适。
optionExplanations_en: Greedy relies on local optimality always producing the global optimum; when that holds, one choice can be committed safely with no need to explore other branches.
Needing to list every valid solution is usually a backtracking scenario, since greedy commits to a single answer rather than enumerating all of them.
Choices that can cause later conflicts and require undo-and-retry are exactly the signal that greedy does not fit and backtracking is needed instead.
Complex constraints without optimal substructure might call for either approach to be evaluated, but that alone does not make greedy the better fit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每一步都直接选当前看起来最优的选项，不再回头验证或尝试其他分支。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A greedy algorithm commits to the locally best choice at each step without going back to try alternatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带剪枝的系统性搜索：做一个选择、递归探索，发现不可能成功就撤销回到上一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

q: 把 AI 编码面试中的回溯工作流按顺序排列。
steps: 提示 AI 生成代码，并明确关键数据结构和剪枝点。
验证撤销状态、剪枝完整性和递归终止。
识别这是组合搜索，并说出为什么约束能剪枝。
先描述决策树：每步选择、状态、约束、base case。
用小输入跑出可人工确认的答案。
why: 先建模再提示，代码出来后按高风险点审查，再用小样例证明。这个顺序展示的是你在驱动 AI，而不是被 AI 驱动。
why_en: The interview workflow is recognize, model the decision tree, prompt specifically, review the failure points, and test small cases.
tradeoff: 先讲清决策树再让 AI 写代码 vs 直接要代码、事后再补救

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每一步可能的选择画成一棵树，用来描述回溯要探索的整个搜索空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A decision tree lays out each step's possible choices as a tree, describing the whole search space backtracking explores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 递归的终止条件：满足它时直接返回结果，不再继续递归下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The base case is the recursion's stopping condition — when it is met, the function returns directly instead of recursing further.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提前判断某个分支不可能得到合法解，直接跳过整棵子树而不再探索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning means recognizing early that a branch cannot lead to a valid solution and skipping its entire subtree.

q: 回溯题里，哪些表现是强信号？
options: 早早说出“系统性搜索 + 剪枝”
在 AI 写代码前讲清决策树
代码生成后主动检查状态恢复、剪枝和终止
只说“递归一下”然后接受第一版输出
why: 面试官看的是你是否能识别模式、表达计划、验证 AI 输出。只接受第一版代码无法证明你理解了算法。
why_en: Strong candidates name the pattern, describe the decision tree, and verify the AI's backtracking failure points.
options_en: Naming the pattern early as 'systematic search plus pruning'.
Describing the decision tree before the AI writes code.
Proactively checking state restoration, pruning, and termination once code is generated.
Just saying 'let's recurse' and accepting the first draft.
optionExplanations: 早点说出“系统性搜索+剪枝”这类词，说明你已经识别出回溯的模式，而不是盲目开始写代码。
在 AI 写代码前讲清每一步的选择、状态和约束，能让生成的代码更贴合你的设计，也方便之后核对。
代码生成后主动检查状态恢复、剪枝、终止条件，说明你在验证输出而不是照单全收。
只说“递归一下”就接受第一版输出，等于把建模和验证责任都交给了 AI，拿不到能证明理解的信号。
optionExplanations_en: Naming it 'systematic search with pruning' early shows you've recognized the backtracking pattern instead of diving into code blindly.
Describing each step's choice, state, and constraint before the AI writes code keeps the generated code close to your design and easy to check afterward.
Proactively checking state restoration, pruning, and termination once code is generated shows you are verifying the output, not just accepting it.
Just saying 'let's recurse' and accepting the first draft hands the modeling and verification responsibility to the AI, giving no signal you understood it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提前判断某个分支不可能得到合法解，直接跳过整棵子树而不再探索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning means recognizing early that a branch cannot lead to a valid solution and skipping its entire subtree.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每一步可能的选择画成一棵树，用来描述回溯要探索的整个搜索空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A decision tree lays out each step's possible choices as a tree, describing the whole search space backtracking explores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 递归返回前把对共享状态做的修改撤销，让下一个分支从干净状态重新开始。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: State restoration undoes a branch's changes to shared state before the next branch starts, so it begins from a clean state.

q: 填空：一句话定义回溯。
text: 回溯是带有{{剪枝}}的{{系统性搜索}}：尝试一个选择，发现不可能成功就退回最近的决策点。
why: 它不是随机试错，而是有结构地遍历选择树，并用约束尽早放弃死路。这个定义能直接转成面试里的开场解释。
why_en: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning, backing up from choices that cannot lead to a solution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带剪枝的系统性搜索：做一个选择、递归探索，发现不可能成功就撤销回到上一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提前判断某个分支不可能得到合法解，直接跳过整棵子树而不再探索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning means recognizing early that a branch cannot lead to a valid solution and skipping its entire subtree.

q: 回溯递归要避免无限循环，最基本的结构要求是什么？
options: 每次递归都必须让问题朝 base case 前进
每个函数只能有一个 for 循环
必须使用全局变量
递归深度必须固定为 2
why: 例如多放一个物品、少一个空格、进入下一行，都是进度。没有进度时，递归可能在同一状态上反复调用。
why_en: Every recursive branch must make measurable progress toward a base case.
options_en: Every recursive call must move the problem toward a base case.
Each function can only have one for loop.
You must use a global variable.
The recursion depth must be fixed at 2.
optionExplanations: 递归调用之间必须留下可观察的差异——比如已放置元素数量、剩余候选数——问题规模才会真正缩小，最终撞到 base case。
for 循环数量是代码风格问题，和递归会不会终止没有必然关系。
全局变量只是共享状态的一种实现方式，用不用它不能保证递归会终止。
回溯的递归深度通常随问题规模变化，固定成 2 不是通用的终止手段。
optionExplanations_en: Each recursive call must leave some observable difference — like more placed items or fewer remaining candidates — so the problem provably shrinks toward the base case.
The number of for loops is a style choice and has no necessary bearing on whether the recursion terminates.
A global variable is just one way to implement shared state; using one does not guarantee the recursion will terminate.
Backtracking's recursion depth normally scales with problem size, so fixing it at 2 is not a general termination technique.

termDefinitions.meaning: 递归的终止条件：满足它时直接返回结果，不再继续递归下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The base case is the recursion's stopping condition — when it is met, the function returns directly instead of recursing further.

scenario: 你审查 AI 写的组合生成器，看到它在递归前 append，但递归后没有对应 pop。
q: 应该要求 AI 做哪项修改？
codeSample:
path.append(choice)
backtrack(i + 1, path)
# missing line here
options: 在递归后加 path.pop()
把 append 改成 sort
删除 base case
把 i + 1 改成 i
why: append 是 choose，递归后必须 pop 才能回到尝试该选择前的路径。否则 path 会累积不属于当前分支的元素。
why_en: A path append before recursion needs a matching pop after recursion to restore branch-local state.
whenOtherWins: 如果每次递归都传入全新的不可变路径副本，则不需要 pop，但会付出更多复制成本。
tradeoff: append(choose)配对pop(unchoose) vs 省略撤销、让路径累积残留元素
options_en: Add path.pop() after the recursive call.
Change append to sort.
Delete the base case.
Change i + 1 to i.
optionExplanations: path 是这次递归里唯一的可变共享对象；每往下一层多了一个元素，回来时必须精确减回同一个元素，否则兄弟分支会读到多余的前缀。
排序不能撤销刚才 append 的元素，也不解决状态污染的问题，方向就错了。
删掉 base case 会让递归失去终止条件，反而制造新的 bug，不是这里要修的问题。
把 i + 1 改成 i 会让递归对同一个位置重复调用，可能导致无限递归，也不是撤销状态的方法。
optionExplanations_en: path is the one shared mutable object across this recursion; each deeper call adds one element, and returning must remove exactly that element, or sibling branches inherit an extra prefix.
Sorting does not undo the element just appended and does not fix the state-contamination problem — it's the wrong fix entirely.
Deleting the base case removes the recursion's stopping condition and introduces a new bug; it's not what this code is missing.
Changing i + 1 to i makes the recursion call itself on the same position repeatedly, risking infinite recursion — also not a way to undo state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把当前选择加入路径（choose）和递归结束后把它移除（unchoose）这一对配套操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: path.append and path.pop are the paired choose and unchoose steps that add a choice to the current path and then remove it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 递归的终止条件：满足它时直接返回结果，不再继续递归下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The base case is the recursion's stopping condition — when it is met, the function returns directly instead of recursing further.

scenario: 题目要求枚举所有把字符串切成若干段且每段满足条件的方案。
q: 这更像哪类回溯形状？
options: 路径或分区问题
单源最短路问题
LRU 缓存设计
最小生成树问题
why: 你在每个位置选择下一段的结束点，合法就继续向后分区，失败就退回改选。它是典型的“路径/分区”组合搜索。
why_en: Enumerating all valid segmentations is a path-or-partition backtracking problem.
whenOtherWins: 如果只问能否分词或分法数量，并且重复前缀状态很多，word break 风格 DP 可能更合适。
tradeoff: 路径/分区式组合搜索(回溯) vs 图上最优路径/树/缓存设计问题
options_en: A path or partition problem.
A single-source shortest-path problem.
An LRU cache design.
A minimum-spanning-tree problem.
optionExplanations: 在每个位置选一个分段的结束点，合法就继续往后分区、不行就退回改选，正是路径/分区类回溯的组合搜索形状。
单源最短路是在带权图上求到各点的最小距离，和按位置切分字符串是不同的问题结构。
LRU 缓存设计是数据结构和淘汰策略问题，不涉及枚举字符串的切分方式。
最小生成树是在带权图里选出连接所有节点、总权重最小的树，和切分字符串没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: Choosing where each segment ends at every position, continuing when it's valid and backing off to retry when it's not, is the path/partition shape of backtracking.
Single-source shortest path finds the minimum distance to every node in a weighted graph, a different problem structure from partitioning a string.
LRU cache design is about data structures and eviction policy, not about enumerating ways to split a string.
A minimum spanning tree selects the least-weight tree connecting all nodes in a weighted graph, unrelated to splitting a string.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从一个固定起点出发，求它到图中其他各节点的最短距离，例如用 BFS 或 Dijkstra。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single-source shortest path finds the minimum distance from one fixed starting node to every other node, using algorithms such as BFS or Dijkstra.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按最近使用时间淘汰最久未被访问数据的缓存策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LRU cache, least recently used cache, evicts whichever entry has gone the longest without being accessed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在带权图中选出连接所有节点、且总权重最小的一棵树。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A minimum spanning tree, MST, connects every node in a weighted graph using the smallest possible total edge weight.

q: 普通约束检查和约束传播的差异是什么？
options: 普通检查判合法；传播还更新未来候选集
传播不需要恢复任何共享状态
普通检查总是比传播更快、剪枝更多
传播只在完全无约束的题目里有用
why: 传播把当前选择的后果提前应用到未来状态。它可能更快，但也扩大了需要正确恢复的共享状态范围。
why_en: Constraint propagation not only validates a choice but also updates future candidate sets implied by that choice.
tradeoff: 提前更新未来候选集(约束传播) vs 只判断当前这一步是否合法(普通检查)
options_en: A plain check only validates the current choice; propagation also updates the feasible set for future choices.
Propagation never needs to restore any shared state.
A plain check is always faster than propagation and prunes more.
Propagation is only useful on problems with no constraints at all.
optionExplanations: 普通检查只回答“这一步能不能走”；约束传播还会把这一步对未来格子的影响算出来，提前收缩它们的候选集。
传播改的候选集也是共享状态，回溯失败时同样要恢复，否则下一分支会在被错误收缩的候选集上搜索。
传播往往能更早排除死路，长期反而剪枝更多；它只是多做了维护候选集的工作，不能一概说普通检查更快。
约束越紧，传播能提前排除的候选越多；只要约束够紧，传播依然有用，不局限于完全无约束的题目。
optionExplanations_en: A plain check only answers 'is this step allowed'; propagation also works out this step's effect on future cells and shrinks their candidate sets early.
The candidate sets propagation changes are shared state too, and they must be restored on backtrack, or the next branch searches an incorrectly shrunk set.
Propagation often rules out dead ends earlier and ends up pruning more overall; it just does extra bookkeeping, so a plain check isn't simply faster.
The tighter the constraints, the more candidates propagation can rule out early; it stays useful as long as constraints are tight, not only with none at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 做一个选择后立刻算出它对未来候选值的影响并从候选集中删除，而不是等真正冲突发生才发现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Constraint propagation immediately works out and removes the future candidate values a choice rules out, instead of waiting until a conflict actually happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个位置当前还允许尝试的值的集合，会随着约束传播不断收缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A candidate set is the collection of values still allowed at a position, which shrinks as constraints propagate.

q: 填空：为什么 `state.undo(choice)` 是回溯模板的关键？
text: 没有 {{state.undo(choice)}}，一个分支的决策会{{泄漏}}到下一个分支，导致搜索状态不再代表当前路径。
why: 回溯默认复用状态对象以减少复制。复用状态就必须保证每条路径结束后状态被恢复。
why_en: Undo is required because backtracking usually reuses mutable state across branches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回溯模板里撤销上一步选择的那一行代码，防止状态污染下一个分支。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: state.undo(choice) is the line in the backtracking template that reverses the last choice so it cannot contaminate the next branch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上一个分支修改过的共享状态没有被撤销，被下一个分支意外沿用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state leak happens when a previous branch's changes to shared state are left in place and get inherited by the next branch.

q: 如果 `is_valid` 漏掉了一个真实约束，最可能发生什么？
options: 算法会探索不该探索的分支，甚至返回非法解
算法自动变成动态规划
只会少用一点内存
答案一定仍然正确，只是顺序不同
why: 剪枝条件是正确性的一部分，而不只是性能优化。漏约束会让非法状态进入结果或污染后续判断。
why_en: A missing validity constraint can make backtracking return invalid solutions, not merely run slower.
options_en: The algorithm explores branches it shouldn't, and may even return invalid solutions.
The algorithm automatically turns into dynamic programming.
It only uses a little less memory.
The answer is still guaranteed correct, just in a different order.
optionExplanations: 剪枝条件本身就是正确性的一部分，漏掉一个约束会让算法走进本该被排除的分支，甚至把非法状态当成解返回。
漏掉约束不会让算法结构改变，回溯不会因此自动变成动态规划。
少剪枝通常意味着探索更多分支，会更占内存和时间，不是“省一点内存”。
漏掉约束改变的是搜到哪些状态，可能直接产出非法解，不只是顺序不同。
optionExplanations_en: The pruning condition is itself part of correctness; missing a constraint lets the algorithm walk into branches that should have been excluded, even returning invalid states as solutions.
Missing a constraint does not change the algorithm's structure; backtracking does not automatically turn into dynamic programming because of it.
Less pruning usually means exploring more branches, which costs more memory and time, not 'a little less memory'.
Missing a constraint changes which states get reached and can directly produce an invalid solution, not just a different ordering of a correct one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提前判断某个分支不可能得到合法解，直接跳过整棵子树而不再探索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning means recognizing early that a branch cannot lead to a valid solution and skipping its entire subtree.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断把某个候选值加入当前状态后是否仍然满足所有约束的检查函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: is_valid is the check that decides whether adding a candidate to the current state would still satisfy every constraint.

scenario: 要把多个班次分给员工，员工有可用时间、最大工时和技能约束；题目要求列出所有合法排班。
q: 为什么回溯是合理选择？
options: 每个班次选择一个员工，放入后可立刻检查约束并剪枝
所有排班都能靠一次排序得到最优
只要用哈希表就能避免组合搜索
因为图一定有负权边
why: 这是受约束分配：逐个班次做选择，违反可用性、工时或技能就停止该分支。题目要所有合法排班，更符合回溯而非贪心。
why_en: Constrained shift assignment fits backtracking because each assignment can be checked and undone while enumerating valid schedules.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需最小化成本且状态可压缩、重复子问题明显，可能要改成 DP 或最小费用流等优化模型。
tradeoff: 逐个分配+可回退剪枝(回溯) vs 一次排序/查表定案(贪心/哈希表)
options_en: Each shift picks one employee, and the assignment can be checked and pruned right away.
Every schedule can be found optimally with a single sort.
A hash table alone avoids the combinatorial search.
Because the graph must have negative-weight edges.
optionExplanations: 这是受约束分配：给每个班次选一个员工后，能立刻检查可用性、工时、技能，违反就退回改选，正是回溯的选择-探索-撤销结构。
排序只能给出一个顺序，不能同时满足可用时间、工时上限和技能这些互相影响的约束，也拿不到全部合法排班。
哈希表能查找或去重，但排班要在组合空间里试错并处理冲突，哈希表本身不做搜索。
这道题不是图上的最短路问题，负权边和排班分配没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: This is constrained assignment: picking one employee per shift lets you immediately check availability, hours, and skills, and back off when a rule is violated.
Sorting only gives one ordering; it cannot simultaneously satisfy interacting constraints like availability, hour limits, and skills, or produce every valid schedule.
A hash table is good for lookup or dedup, but scheduling needs trial-and-error search over a combination space with conflicts, which it does not do alone.
This isn't a shortest-path problem on a graph; negative-weight edges have nothing to do with shift assignment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带剪枝的系统性搜索：做一个选择、递归探索，发现不可能成功就撤销回到上一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用键直接定位值的数据结构，常用于 O(1) 级别的查找或计数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys directly to values, giving roughly constant-time lookup or counting.

q: 哪些信号说明你应该考虑 DP，而不是纯回溯？
options: 目标是最小成本、最大收益等单个最优值
同一个状态会从多条路径重复出现
题目问的是所有排列或所有合法配置
可以用“前 i 个元素、预算 j”清楚定义状态
why: 最优值、重复状态和清晰状态定义都指向 DP。枚举全部合法配置通常仍是回溯的主场。
why_en: Optimization, repeated states, and a clean indexed state definition are strong DP signals.
tradeoff: 最优值+重复状态+可索引状态定义(转向DP) vs 求全部合法解(仍是回溯)
options_en: The goal is a single optimal value, like minimum cost or maximum profit.
The same state is reached repeatedly from multiple paths.
The problem asks for all permutations or all valid configurations.
The state can be cleanly defined as 'first i elements, budget j'.
optionExplanations: 只求一个最优值（最小成本、最大收益）而不是列出所有解，是典型的动态规划信号。
不同路径反复到达同一个状态，说明存在重叠子问题，缓存结果能避免重复搜索，这是 DP 的核心动机。
要枚举所有排列或所有合法配置，通常仍然是回溯的主场，而不是转向 DP 的信号。
能用“前 i 个元素、预算 j”这类简洁下标描述状态，说明状态可以被有限地索引，适合做成 DP 表或缓存。
optionExplanations_en: Wanting a single optimal value, like minimum cost or maximum profit, instead of listing all solutions, is a classic dynamic-programming signal.
Different paths repeatedly reaching the same state means there are overlapping subproblems, and caching the result avoids re-searching them.
Needing to enumerate every permutation or every valid configuration is usually still backtracking's home turf, not a signal to switch to DP.
Being able to describe the state with a compact index like 'first i elements, budget j' means it can be indexed cleanly, fitting a DP table or cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 动态规划（DP）：通过缓存重叠子问题的结果来求最优值或计数，避免重复计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming, DP, caches the results of overlapping subproblems to compute an optimal value or a count without redoing the same work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同的搜索路径会反复计算同一个子问题，是应该考虑动态规划的信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overlapping subproblems happen when different search paths recompute the same subproblem, a signal that dynamic programming may help.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带剪枝的系统性搜索：做一个选择、递归探索，发现不可能成功就撤销回到上一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is systematic search with pruning that tries a choice, recurses into it, and undoes it if that path cannot succeed.

scenario: 你的搜索状态可以被表示成 `(index, remaining_capacity)`，并且不同选择路径会反复到达同一状态。
q: 向面试官说明的最佳下一步是什么？
options: 继续纯回溯，不做任何缓存
给状态加缓存；这相当于从回溯过渡到自顶向下 DP
删掉所有 base case
用 DFS 一定能得到最短路
why: 可哈希状态和重复到达说明缓存有意义。说出“回溯 + memo 约等于 top-down DP”能展示你理解模式边界。
why_en: A compact repeated state is the cue to memoize and effectively move toward top-down DP.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目要求枚举每个不同解，缓存布尔可行性可能会丢失具体解，需要谨慎设计缓存内容。
tradeoff: 缓存重复到达的状态(memo/自顶向下DP) vs 继续纯回溯重复搜索
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Search[Backtracking] --> Repeat[Repeated state]
  Repeat --> Cache[Memo]
  Cache --> TopDown[Top down DP]
options_en: Keep doing pure backtracking with no caching at all.
Add a cache to the state; this effectively moves from backtracking to top-down DP.
Delete all the base cases.
DFS is guaranteed to find the shortest path.
optionExplanations: 状态可哈希且被多条路径重复到达却不缓存，等于放弃了本可以避免的重复搜索。
(index, remaining_capacity) 这种可哈希、会被重复到达的状态是加缓存的信号；缓存后本质就是自顶向下动态规划。
删掉 base case 会让递归失去终止条件，和处理重复状态无关，还会引入新问题。
DFS 本身不保证找到最短路径，这是图搜索里的另一个话题，与这里的重复状态无关。
optionExplanations_en: A hashable state that's reached repeatedly by different paths without caching means giving up avoidable repeated search.
A hashable, repeatedly-reached state like (index, remaining_capacity) is the signal to add a cache; once cached, it's effectively top-down dynamic programming.
Deleting base cases removes the recursion's stopping condition, has nothing to do with handling repeated states, and introduces a new bug.
DFS by itself does not guarantee finding a shortest path — that's a separate graph-search topic unrelated to the repeated-state issue here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的子问题结果缓存起来，下次遇到相同状态直接查表复用，不用重新搜索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Memoization caches the result of a subproblem so that a repeated state can be looked up instead of being searched again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从原问题出发递归拆解，用缓存记住已经算过的状态，等价于加了记忆化的回溯。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-down DP recurses from the original problem and caches states it has already solved, effectively backtracking with memoization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索：沿一条路径尽量往下走，走不通再回头，是回溯常用的遍历方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS, depth-first search, follows one path as far as possible before backtracking to try another, which is how backtracking usually traverses.

scenario: 你准备让 AI 写通用回溯代码，但需要先给出足够结构避免它猜错。
q: 下面哪个提示最符合文章建议？
options: 只说“写个递归函数就行”
点名状态、候选集合、约束和撤销动作
只说“随便用你觉得最快的算法”
只说“先别写测试，跑完再说”
why: 好提示明确了枚举目标、状态、候选生成、约束和撤销动作。它仍把具体代码交给 AI，但不把建模责任外包。
why_en: A good backtracking prompt names the state, choices, constraints, and undo step without outsourcing the model of the problem.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是标准 N 皇后或排列生成，简短提示也可能够用，但面试中仍应口头讲清模型。
tradeoff: 把状态/候选/约束/撤销讲清楚 vs 只给一句模糊指令
options_en: Just say 'write a recursive function'.
Name the state, the candidate set, the constraints, and the undo step.
Just say 'use whatever algorithm you think is fastest'.
Just say 'skip the tests for now, run it first'.
optionExplanations: 只说写个递归函数，AI 还是要自己猜状态、候选和约束怎么定义，建模责任没有转移出去。
点名枚举目标、状态怎么表示、每步候选是什么、约束检查什么、要不要撤销，生成的代码更贴合设计，也更容易核对。
“随便用最快算法”没有说清楚问题是枚举所有解还是求一个值，AI 可能选错完全不适合回溯场景的方法。
不写测试会让你更难用小样例核对正确性，也不符合先建模、再验证的流程。
optionExplanations_en: Just saying 'write a recursive function' still leaves the AI to guess the state, candidates, and constraints; the modeling responsibility never actually moves.
Naming the enumeration goal, state representation, per-step choices, constraints, and whether to undo produces code closer to your design and easier to verify.
'Use whatever algorithm is fastest' doesn't say whether you want all solutions or a single value, so the AI might pick an approach that doesn't fit backtracking.
Skipping tests makes it harder to verify correctness with small hand-checkable cases and breaks the model-then-verify workflow.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用什么数据结构记录当前已经做出的选择，例如棋盘、路径列表或候选集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: State representation is the data structure that records the choices made so far, such as a board, a path list, or a set of candidates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断把某个候选值加入当前状态后是否仍然满足所有约束的检查函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: is_valid is the check that decides whether adding a candidate to the current state would still satisfy every constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回溯模板里撤销上一步选择的那一行代码，防止状态污染下一个分支。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: state.undo(choice) is the line in the backtracking template that reverses the last choice so it cannot contaminate the next branch.

q: 审查带约束传播的回溯解法时，按正确顺序排列验证步骤。
steps: 跑一个很小且答案已知的实例，确认没有漏解或错解。
确认每次递归前保存或记录了所有会被传播修改的状态。
确认失败回溯时棋盘和候选集都恢复到尝试前。
确认传播函数覆盖所有受影响的邻居或资源。
先读清楚哪些结构是共享可变状态。
why: 先识别共享状态和传播范围，再检查保存/恢复，最后用小样例验证。否则你可能只看到棋盘恢复，却漏掉候选集污染。
why_en: For propagation-heavy backtracking, identify shared state, verify propagation coverage and restoration, then test a known small case.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个位置当前还允许尝试的值的集合，会随着约束传播不断收缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A candidate set is the collection of values still allowed at a position, which shrinks as constraints propagate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 做一个选择后立刻算出它对未来候选值的影响并从候选集中删除，而不是等真正冲突发生才发现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Constraint propagation immediately works out and removes the future candidate values a choice rules out, instead of waiting until a conflict actually happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 递归返回前把对共享状态做的修改撤销，让下一个分支从干净状态重新开始。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: State restoration undoes a branch's changes to shared state before the next branch starts, so it begins from a clean state.
